system.longDesc:
Requirement: Protection Arcana (Master)

Cost: 10 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 18

Test: None

You surround a subject within 25 yards (which may be yourself) with a protective field of magical force. The arcane barrier immune to damage, but also cannot move from the spot (as the barrier is immobile), make melee or ranged attacks, or give or receive items. Effects that do not cause direct damage still affect the subject normally, and spells of all kinds can pass out of the barrier. You can extend the barrier by spending 5 PP for each additional round you would like it to last.
